f.title: Send ADR, failure, error and ESAVI reports online via eReporting Industria
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must send notifications of suspected adverse drug reactions (RAM), therapeutic failures (FT), medication errors (EM) and events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation (ESAVI) online through eReporting Industria, using the E2B upload module or the manual entry module.

rows.quote: Los Titulares de Registro Sanitario deberán realizar el envío de notificaciones de sospechas de Reacciones Adversa a Medicamentos (RAM), Falla Terapéutica (FT), Errores de Medicación (EM) y Eventos supuestamente atribuidos a vacunación e inmunización (ESAVI), de forma online a través de e-reporting industria con módulo de carga E2B o módulo de carga manual,
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing Authorisation Holders shall send notifications of suspected Adverse Drug Reactions (ADR), Therapeutic Failure (TF), Medication Errors (ME) and Events Supposedly Attributable to Vaccination and Immunisation (ESAVI) online through e-Reporting Industria with the E2B upload module or the manual upload module,

f.title: Use the yellow form or primary eReporting only in justified exceptional cases
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders may notify through the yellow form (ficha amarilla) or the primary e-reporting link only in duly justified exceptional cases.
f.exceptions: Only in duly justified exceptional cases

rows.quote: Los Titulares de Registro Sanitario podrán notificar a tráves del formato de ficha amarilla o e-reporting sólo en casos excepcionales debidamente justificados.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing Authorisation Holders may notify through the yellow form format or e-reporting only in duly justified exceptional cases.

f.title: Meet the prerequisites for eReporting Industria access
f.statement: Access to eReporting Industria requires: an up-to-date act constituting the Pharmacovigilance Unit filed with the CNFV; a request for creation of a user account addressed to the Technical Directorate of Post-Market Surveillance and Control, in which the holder marks the module (E2B or manual) it will use; a commitment letter completed by the pharmacovigilance responsible person and/or legal representative; a MedDRA licence valid when access is requested; and a WHODrug licence (for both XML/E2B and manual entry users).
f.clause: 3.3 e-Reporting Industria, 3.1.1 Requisitos para otorgar acceso

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Requisitos para otorgar acceso a e-Reporting Industria son: a. Acta de conformación de la Unidad de Farmacovigilancia (UFV) actualizado ante el CNFV.
rows.location: 3.3 e-Reporting Industria, 3.1.1 Requisitos para otorgar acceso
rows.review_note: Review: list items b-f summarised from the same section (quote shows the lead-in and item a; e-mail addresses omitted). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement beyond the quote, 86.
rows.quote_en: The requirements for granting access to e-Reporting Industria are: a. Act constituting the Pharmacovigilance Unit (UFV), updated with the CNFV.

f.title: Hold valid MedDRA and WHODrug licences to use eReporting Industria
f.statement: A MedDRA licence valid at the time access is requested is an indispensable requirement for marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments to use eReporting Industria; a WHODrug licence applies both to those submitting XML/E2B files and to those using the manual data-entry module.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Es un requerimiento indispensable para el uso de eReporting Industria que los titulares de registro sanitario y establecimientos farmacéuticos tengan la licencia MedDRA vigente correspondiente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: It is an indispensable requirement for the use of eReporting Industria that marketing authorisation holders and pharmaceutical establishments hold the corresponding valid MedDRA licence.

f.title: Use corporate e-mail accounts for eReporting Industria users and request changes
f.statement: At most two eReporting Industria accounts are granted per pharmaceutical establishment through its Pharmacovigilance Unit; it is recommended that the main user be the unit's generic pharmacovigilance mailbox and the additional account that of the pharmacovigilance responsible person. Accounts must be corporate or institutional e-mail addresses, and changes (for example a new PV unit head) must be requested from the CNFV with the items a, b and c of the access requirements.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Las mismas que deberán ser correos corporativos o institucionales.
rows.review_note: Review: short quote; the two-account limit (authority rule) and recommended set-up (se recomienda) are context summarised in the statement. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement beyond the quote, 84.
rows.quote_en: These shall be corporate or institutional e-mail addresses.

f.title: Use eReporting Industria only for new cases; follow up legacy cases on their original channel
f.statement: Individual case notification through eReporting Industria is solely for new cases and their follow-ups. Cases first notified through the eReporting link or the official form must be followed up and closed by e-mail using the official forms; cases first notified as XML (E2B) by e-mail must be followed up through eReporting Industria.

rows.quote: La notificación de casos individuales de sospechas de eventos adversos a través de eReporting Industria, será única y exclusivamente para nuevos casos y sus respectivos seguimientos.
rows.review_note: Review: legacy-case routing rules from the two following bullets added to the statement. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Notification of individual cases of suspected adverse events through eReporting Industria shall be solely and exclusively for new cases and their respective follow-ups.

f.title: Download and keep E2B acknowledgements within 35 days
f.statement: The E2B upload module is used only by holders authorised by the CNFV. After uploading an XML file, the acknowledgement (acklog) should be downloaded as soon as possible because the system keeps only 35 days of history; the sender is responsible for keeping a back-up of the acklogs, which the CNFV cannot regenerate once deleted.
f.clause: 3.3 e-Reporting Industria, 3.1.7 Módulo de carga de E2B (Nota)

rows.quote: Es responsabilidad del emisor tener respaldo de los acklog generados, ya que el CNFV no podrá generar nuevamente acklog una vez que se eliminen del histórico.
rows.location: 3.3 e-Reporting Industria, 3.1.7 Módulo de carga de E2B (Nota)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: It is the sender's responsibility to keep a back-up of the acklogs generated, since the CNFV will not be able to regenerate an acklog once they are deleted from the history.

f.title: Cite the bibliographic reference for literature cases and record the true source
f.statement: For literature cases the bibliographic reference from which the case was obtained must be added in the bibliographic references field. If the origin of the case is unclear the report type "other" must be chosen; the option "not available to sender" must not be used when the source of the report is known.
f.clause: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (tipo de reporte)
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Se deberá agregar necesariamente la referencia bibliográfica de donde se obtuvo el caso, colocándola en el campo Referencias bibliográficas (ver Referencias bibliográficas). Si no es clara la procedencia del caso debe elegir la opción “otro” como tipo de reporte. La opción “no disponible para el remitente” no debe ser utilizada, cuando se conoce la fuente del reporte.
rows.location: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (tipo de reporte)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The bibliographic reference from which the case was obtained shall necessarily be added, placing it in the Bibliographic References field (see Bibliographic References). If the origin of the case is not clear, the option "other" must be chosen as the report type. The option "not available to sender" must not be used when the source of the report is known.

f.title: Record day zero as the first receipt of the minimum information
f.statement: The date the case was first received is the date the reporter (sender) first received it with the minimum information (day zero); the date of most recent information is when the sender received the latest information giving rise to a follow-up.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.quote: Fecha en que se recibió el caso por primera vez: Fecha de reporte por primera vez por el notificador (emisor) con la información mínima (día cero).
rows.review_note: Review: data-field definition that fixes the clock start; Mandatory as a field rule. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: definition row, 86.
rows.quote_en: Date the case was first received: date of first report to the reporter (sender) with the minimum information (day zero).

f.title: Flag fatal cases and clusters of serious cases for priority attention
f.statement: Answer "YES" to whether the case meets local criteria for priority attention for serious notifications with a fatal outcome and for clusters of two or more similar serious cases in the same place with the same medicine or vaccine and the same batch; answer "NO" for serious notifications with other outcomes and for non-serious notifications.
f.clause: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (criterios locales de atención prioritaria)
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.quote: Colocar “SI”: Notificaciones graves que tengan consecuencia muerte y aquellos que cumplan el criterio dos casos graves o más, semejantes en el mismo lugar, con el mismo medicamento o vacuna y del mismo lote.
rows.location: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (criterios locales de atención prioritaria)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Enter "YES": serious notifications with death as a consequence and those meeting the criterion of two or more similar serious cases in the same place, with the same medicine or vaccine and of the same batch.

f.title: Set fixed case identifiers (WWUID/SRUID) with consecutive numbering
f.statement: The root of the worldwide unique case identifier (country ISO code EC plus company short name) must be agreed with the CNFV and not changed afterwards. In the manual module the variable part of the WWUID and SRUID must be a consecutive number of at least 5 digits, unique for each case, starting at 00001; the identifiers cannot be edited in follow-ups, so they must be entered correctly in the initial report. Other internal IDs go in the field for other case identifiers.

rows.quote: La raíz del WWUID, es decir, el Country ISO code (EC) y el nombre corto, debe quedar establecido junto con el CNFV (Formato FE-B.X.X.X-FCVXX-XX) y no debe modificarse posteriormente.
rows.review_note: Review: consecutive-number and non-editable rules taken from the following paragraphs of the same section. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: The root of the WWUID, i.e. the Country ISO code (EC) and the short name, must be established together with the CNFV (Form FE-B.X.X.X-FCVXX-XX) and must not be modified afterwards.

f.title: Assess causality of each reported event before sending it to the CNFV
f.statement: Notifications of suspected adverse events sent to the CNFV must have been assessed with causality algorithms, including the WHO categories (certain, probable, possible, conditional and unlikely); the method used and the assessment source (the company pharmacovigilance unit first, optionally also the primary reporter) are recorded.
f.clause: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (evaluación de causalidad)

rows.quote: Las notificaciones de sospechas de eventos adversos de medicamentos que se envían al CNFV deben estar evaluadas aplicando algoritmos de análisis de causalidad, entre ellas las categorías definidas por la Organización Mundial de la Salud (Definida, probable, posible, condicional e improbable).
rows.location: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (evaluación de causalidad)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Notifications of suspected adverse drug events sent to the CNFV must be assessed by applying causality analysis algorithms, including the categories defined by the World Health Organization (Certain, probable, possible, conditional and unlikely).

f.title: Write the case narrative in the original reporter's words
f.statement: The case narrative must reproduce the words and phrases used by the initial/original reporter, keeping the original narrative; it must cite the clinical manifestations, the diagnosis that led to the medication, the signs and symptoms of the reaction, treatments for the reaction, the kind of other safety problem where relevant (overdose, suspected falsification, misuse, abuse, medication error, off-label use, occupational exposure), follow-up information separated as Follow-up 1, 2, 3 and whether the case is closed or needs follow-up.
f.clause: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte, 7. Caso narrativo
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.quote: Caso narrativo: Deberá colocar la narrativa del caso con las palabras y frases utilizadas por el notificador inicial/original (tal cual fue notificado por éste), manteniendo la narrativa original.
rows.location: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte, 7. Caso narrativo
rows.review_note: Review: narrative content items summarised from the rest of item 7. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Case narrative: You shall enter the case narrative with the words and phrases used by the initial/original reporter (exactly as notified by them), keeping the original narrative.

f.title: Download the case XML after every manual submission and keep it for follow-up
f.statement: After sending a report in the manual module the XML file of the case must be downloaded immediately and kept, as it is the only way to obtain it and to submit follow-ups; the XML and acklog remain available in the submission-status section for only 35 days. Follow-ups are made by editing the report from that XML, adding the new information under "Follow-up 1, 2", sending it and downloading the new XML; the acklog must not be used for follow-up.
f.clause: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (descarga); 3.1.8.3 Editar un reporte

rows.quote: Descargar reporte: Una vez que haya enviado el reporte, es necesario descargarlo inmediatamente, ya que será la única forma de obtener este archivo XML del caso y de realizar un seguimiento correspondiente.
rows.location: 3.1.8.2 Crear un nuevo reporte (descarga); 3.1.8.3 Editar un reporte
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Download report: Once you have sent the report, it is necessary to download it immediately, as this will be the only way to obtain this XML file of the case and to make a corresponding follow-up.

f.title: Nullify erroneous or duplicate reports with a reason and the duplicate WWUID
f.statement: Erroneous or duplicate reports are nullified directly in the platform by uploading the correct XML file; the reason for deletion must be given and, for a duplicate, the WWUID of the case it duplicates.

rows.quote: En el campo “Motivo de la eliminación” deberá proporcionar necesariamente la razón por la cual requiere eliminar el reporte. Si es por duplicidad, deberá colocar el WWUID con el cual se ha duplicado el reporte.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In the "Reason for deletion" field you shall necessarily give the reason why you need to delete the report. If it is due to duplication, you shall enter the WWUID with which the report has been duplicated.

f.title: Report download failures to the CNFV and re-enter the case with the same identifiers
f.statement: If a technical failure of the platform prevents downloading the file of an initial case or follow-up, the user must e-mail the CNFV with the subject "Falla en la descarga del archivo eReporting industria", giving the WWUID and the date the case was entered; using the PDF the CNFV returns, the user must re-enter the case with the follow-up information using exactly the same WWUID and SRUID, download the file and reply to the CNFV. Internet instability or the user omitting the download step are not exceptional situations.
f.clause: 3.1.8.5 Situaciones especiales en el módulo de carga manual

rows.quote: Si el sistema no permitió la descarga del archivo del caso inicial o seguimiento por falla técnica, debe enviar un correo electrónico a la cuenta:
rows.location: 3.1.8.5 Situaciones especiales en el módulo de carga manual

rows.quote_en: If the system did not allow the download of the file of the initial case or follow-up due to a technical failure, you must send an e-mail to the account:

f.title: Confirm acceptance of each report by loading or reading its acknowledgement
f.statement: The submission status only shows that the report left eReporting Industria for VigiFlow, which may still reject it; acceptance by the authority is confirmed by loading the acklog (holders with a database that can load it) or reading it (manual-entry holders), checking the acknowledgement codes (E2B R2 01 = accepted; E2B R3 AA/CA = accepted; CR, AE, AR or 02/03 = rejected or partial).
f.clause: 3.1.8.6 Estado de envío y revisión de acklogs
f.systems: eReporting Industria; VigiFlow; ICH E2B(R2); ICH E2B(R3)

rows.quote: El medio para comprobar que el reporte ha sido recibido correctamente por la autoridad reguladora (para ambos módulos) es la carga del acklog (para TRS/TCRS que tienen la base de datos donde el acklog puede cargarse) o la lectura del acklog (para TRS/TCRS de entrada manual).
rows.location: 3.1.8.6 Estado de envío y revisión de acklogs
rows.review_note: Review: descriptive wording; checking acceptance is the practical duty. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: implied duty, 86.
rows.quote_en: The means of verifying that the report has been correctly received by the regulatory authority (for both modules) is loading the acklog (for MAHs that have a database where the acklog can be loaded) or reading the acklog (for manual-entry MAHs).

f.title: Include the minimum criteria in every adverse event report
f.statement: An adverse event report must contain at least: administrative and report-identification information; patient information (initials, age; weight and height where specifically applicable); suspect medicine information (generic name, trade name, treatment dates, batch number and registration number); information on the suspected adverse event (name of the clinical manifestation using MedDRA, onset date and end date if available); and reporter information (name or initials).
f.clause: 4. Criterios mínimos que deben constar en el reporte de un evento adverso a medicamentos
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders

f.title: Notify all suspected ADRs, failures, errors, off-label and ESAVI for products marketed in Ecuador
f.statement: All suspected adverse drug reactions, therapeutic failures, medication errors, off-label use and ESAVI involving medicines in general, biologicals, medicines with controlled substances and processed natural products for medicinal use that hold a national registration and are manufactured and marketed in Ecuador, as well as imported products, those authorised by exception and those entering by homologation, must be notified; priority is given to serious reactions and to medicines recently marketed in the country.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Se deberá notificar todas las sospechas de Reacciones Adversas a Medicamentos (RAM), Fallas Terapéuticas (FT), Errores de Medicación (EM), Off Label (OL) y Eventos Supuestamente Atribuibles a la Vacunación o Inmunización (ESAVI) que involucren a los medicamentos en general, medicamentos biológicos, medicamentos que contengan sustancias catalogadas sujetas a fiscalización y productos naturales procesados de uso medicinal que poseen registro sanitario nacional, que se fabriquen y comercialicen en el país; así como aquellos importados, los autorizados por excepción o los que ingresan del extranjero por homologación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: All suspected Adverse Drug Reactions (ADR), Therapeutic Failures (TF), Medication Errors (ME), Off Label use (OL) and Events Supposedly Attributable to Vaccination or Immunisation (ESAVI) involving medicines in general, biological medicines, medicines containing controlled substances subject to oversight and processed natural products for medicinal use that hold a national sanitary registration and are manufactured and marketed in the country shall be notified; as well as those imported, those authorised by exception or those entering from abroad by homologation.

f.title: Notify serious suspected AEs to ARCSA within 15 days
f.statement: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders must notify every suspected serious adverse event, expected or unexpected, at the latest 15 days after the event became known.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Los Establecimientos Farmacéuticos y titulares de registro sanitario deberán notificar toda sospecha de eventos adversos graves sean estos esperados o inesperados como máximo 15 días después de conocido el evento;
rows.review_note: Review: "días" not qualified; read as calendar days. Foreign cases go through PSURs (7 b), so origin domestic. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: unit inferred, 88.
rows.quote_en: Pharmaceutical Establishments and marketing authorisation holders shall notify every suspected serious adverse event, whether expected or unexpected, at the latest 15 days after the event becomes known;

f.title: Notify non-serious suspected AEs to ARCSA within 30 days
f.statement: Non-serious suspected adverse events, expected or unexpected, must be notified at the latest 30 days after the event became known.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments and marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: mientras que los no graves sean estos esperados o inesperados deberán ser notificados como máximo 30 días posteriores de conocido el evento.

rows.quote_en: while non-serious ones, whether expected or unexpected, shall be notified at the latest 30 days after the event becomes known.

f.title: Report foreign suspected AEs through periodic safety reports
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder must notify suspected adverse events occurring in other countries where clinical studies are conducted and/or the product is marketed through the Periodic Safety Reports, according to the instructions ARCSA issues.
f.applicability: Suspected adverse events from other countries

rows.quote: El titular del Registro Sanitario deberá notificar las sospechas de eventos adversos que se produzcan en otros países donde se realicen estudios clínicos y/o se comercialice el producto por medio de los Informes Periódicos de Seguridad, de acuerdo al Instructivo que la Agencia emita para el efecto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The Marketing Authorisation Holder shall notify suspected adverse events occurring in other countries where clinical studies are carried out and/or the product is marketed by means of the Periodic Safety Reports, in accordance with the Instructions that the Agency issues for this purpose.

f.title: Fall back to the scanned yellow form by e-mail when online reporting fails
f.statement: If the holder cannot send notifications through eReporting Industria or another online means within the time limits, it must fill in and scan the CNFV-approved notification form (yellow form) and send it by e-mail to the CNFV; once the problem is resolved it is asked to enter the case on the platform and inform the CNFV by e-mail for verification.

rows.quote: Si el Titular de Registro Sanitario no puede enviar por eReporting industria u otro medio online las notificaciones de sospechas de eventos adversos en los plazos establecidos en la normativa vigente, deberá llenar ydigitalizar el formato de notificación de sospecha de evento adverso aprobado por el CNFV (Ficha amarilla)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: If the Marketing Authorisation Holder cannot send notifications of suspected adverse events through eReporting Industria or another online means within the time limits established in current regulations, it shall fill in and digitise the suspected adverse event notification format approved by the CNFV (Yellow form)
